interpretation: Source-bound facts, not complete authored anatomy/accessibility contracts. Default expressions are source text, not evaluated values. Rest bindings do not prove DOM forwarding. Prompt keyboard text is a declared contract; tests and manual AT acceptance remain separate.

components.name: AIDisclosureBadge
components.declaredKeyboard: Tab reaches the disclosure button; Enter/Space toggles it. Escape dismisses the open disclosure through the shared overlay stack.

components.name: Accordion
components.declaredKeyboard: Native Tab reaches each section button; Enter/Space toggles it. Closed panel content is unmounted. defaultOpen seeds state once; changing items does not reset it. Titles must name the buttons and should contain no nested interactive control.

components.name: Alert
components.declaredKeyboard: The message container adds no keyboard commands. If `onDismiss` is supplied, Tab reaches a native dismiss button and Enter/Space invokes it; the caller removes the alert.

components.name: AlertDialog
components.declaredKeyboard: The modal layer moves focus and traps Tab/Shift+Tab. Destructive alerts initially focus Cancel; ordinary confirmations initially focus Confirm. Confirm closes or requests closure before invoking onConfirm; Cancel, backdrop and Escape also invoke onCancel. Controlled open requires the caller to apply onOpenChange. Callbacks are synchronous notifications; the UI does not execute, authorize or await the consequential operation.

components.name: Anchor
components.declaredKeyboard: Tab reaches native in-page links; Enter follows their target IDs. Targets must exist in the same document when the observer effect runs. The scrollspy tracks intersecting targets and retains its last location when none intersect.

components.name: AspectRatio
components.declaredKeyboard: The wrapper adds no keyboard action; interactive children retain their own behavior. The `ratio` prop determines the wrapper’s aspect ratio even if caller `style` supplies another aspectRatio.

components.name: Avatar
components.declaredKeyboard: Avatar and AvatarGroup add no keyboard action. A surrounding link/button owns focus and activation.

components.name: AvatarGroup
components.declaredKeyboard: Avatar and AvatarGroup add no keyboard action. A surrounding link/button owns focus and activation.

components.name: BackTop
components.declaredKeyboard: After the scroll threshold, Tab reaches the native button and Enter/Space scrolls to the top. The activation reads the current reduced-motion preference.

components.name: Badge
components.declaredKeyboard: The badge adds no keyboard commands; any interactive child owns its own behavior. The dot is decorative.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.declaredKeyboard: Tab reaches native links before the final current-page item; Enter follows them. The last item is noninteractive current-page text. Supply explicit destinations for earlier items; omitted href uses #.

components.name: Button
components.declaredKeyboard: Uses native button focus and Enter/Space activation. `loading` disables the button and sets `aria-busy`; the default type is `button`, so set `type="submit"` for form submission.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.declaredKeyboard: The wrapper has `role="group"`; each child retains its own native keyboard behavior. It does not provide arrow navigation or selection state.

components.name: Calendar
components.declaredKeyboard: Tab reaches month navigation and one active day within the semantic grid. Enter/Space selects. Arrow keys move by day/week across month boundaries; PageUp/PageDown moves by month (Shift moves by year), clamping the day in shorter months. Home/End retains the established first/last day of month contract. Selection is exposed on the gridcell; aria-pressed remains on its native button for compatibility. Full localized date labels use Intl.DateTimeFormat.

components.name: Card
components.declaredKeyboard: An interactive Card defaults to a native button with Enter/Space activation. An explicit `as` overrides that tag; the caller then owns appropriate keyboard behavior, focus and semantics. Avoid interactive descendants inside a button card.

components.name: CardBody
components.declaredKeyboard: An interactive Card defaults to a native button with Enter/Space activation. An explicit `as` overrides that tag; the caller then owns appropriate keyboard behavior, focus and semantics. Avoid interactive descendants inside a button card.

components.name: CardFooter
components.declaredKeyboard: An interactive Card defaults to a native button with Enter/Space activation. An explicit `as` overrides that tag; the caller then owns appropriate keyboard behavior, focus and semantics. Avoid interactive descendants inside a button card.

components.name: CardHeader
components.declaredKeyboard: An interactive Card defaults to a native button with Enter/Space activation. An explicit `as` overrides that tag; the caller then owns appropriate keyboard behavior, focus and semantics. Avoid interactive descendants inside a button card.

components.name: Carousel
components.declaredKeyboard: Native Tab reaches controls, dots and focusable active-slide content; Enter/Space activates buttons. Previous/next wrap; the component adds no arrow-key navigation or automatic rotation. startIndex seeds once, and collection shrink clamps the stored index.

components.name: Cascader
components.declaredKeyboard: Down/Enter/Space opens the field. After opening, Down from the still-focused trigger enters the first option. While open, Up/Down and Home/End move through options; Right activates the focused option, including leaf selection. Left collapses toward the parent; Escape dismisses. Apply leaf `onChange` paths to `value`.

components.name: Chart
components.declaredKeyboard: The figure is exposed as one named image, with decorative SVG content; this component has no interactive keyboard controls. Supply data suited to the selected visualization, finite nonnegative values and a useful positive height. These caller input limits are guidance, not runtime normalization or proof for arbitrary numeric values.

components.name: ChatMessage
components.declaredKeyboard: The message frame has no keyboard commands. Interactive child content retains its own keyboard behavior.

components.name: Checkbox
components.declaredKeyboard: Uses native checkbox focus and Space toggling; the wrapping label associates the supplied text with the input. Disabled behavior follows the native input.

components.name: CitationList
components.declaredKeyboard: Rows with `href` are native links reached with Tab and activated with Enter; rows without a link have no keyboard action.

components.name: CodeBlock
components.declaredKeyboard: Tab reaches the native copy button when showBar is true; Enter/Space requests clipboard write. Copied feedback follows a successful current write only, and code changes/unmount invalidate old completions.

components.name: Collapsible
components.declaredKeyboard: Native Enter/Space toggles the button; the named region mounts only when open. title takes precedence over trigger when non-null. open with onOpenChange is controlled; defaultOpen seeds uncontrolled state. Use a descriptive non-interactive button label.

components.name: ColorPicker
components.declaredKeyboard: Tab reaches the field, swatch buttons and custom hex input. Native Enter/Space activates buttons; Enter or blur on the input proposes a valid six-digit hex value, and Escape closes the popup. Controlled callers update `value`. Enter ignores composition-marked/keyCode229 keydowns; handled Enter cancels its native default action so restoring field focus does not activate the field again. Blur behavior is unchanged.

components.name: Combobox
components.declaredKeyboard: Typing filters options; Up/Down changes the highlighted option, Enter selects it, and Escape dismisses the popup. Arrow and Enter handlers ignore keys flagged as composing by nativeEvent.isComposing or legacy keyCode 229; ordinary text input still updates the local filter. Supply `label` for field context and apply `onChange` to `value`.

components.name: CommandPalette
components.declaredKeyboard: The caller opens the controlled overlay and registers any Cmd/Ctrl+K shortcut. The shared modal layer focuses search and traps focus; native Tab reaches action buttons and Enter/Space activates them. Escape requests onClose. There is no arrow-key result navigation; the query persists while the same component instance remains mounted.

components.name: Comment
components.declaredKeyboard: Tab reaches each native action button; Enter/Space calls its supplied onSelect. The default Reply button has a localized label and no reply handler; provide actions to implement reply behavior.

components.name: ConfidenceMeter
components.declaredKeyboard: This is a display-only meter and does not add a keyboard action.

components.name: ContextMenu
components.declaredKeyboard: The named zone is a tab stop by default. Shift+F10 or the ContextMenu key opens from the focused zone or a focused descendant; the first action receives focus. Up/Down move without wrapping; Home/End reach the first/last action and separators are skipped. Enter/Space selects once. Tab exits and closes without forcing focus back; Escape closes the top layer and returns focus to the opener; selection also restores focus before calling the action. Opening and navigation ignore caller-prevented keys. Keys flagged as composing (isComposing or legacy keyCode 229) do not open, navigate, close on Tab, or dismiss on Escape. Ordinary Tab closes after native or parent-modal focus movement, including a Tab canceled by that modal trap. Use tabIndex={-1} only when a focusable descendant or alternate control provides keyboard access. Empty/all-separator items do not open a menu. No touch gesture or native operating-system shortcut acceptance is claimed; provide alternate actions where needed.

components.name: DataGrid
components.declaredKeyboard: This is a semantic table with native sorting buttons and selection checkboxes, rather than an arrow-key grid widget. Enter/Space cycles a sortable column ascending, descending and unsorted, or toggles a checkbox. The caller applies selected/onSelect and supplies unique stable rowKey values for selectable rows. Select-all acts on the filtered set and clears the selection when that set is fully selected.

components.name: DataTable
components.declaredKeyboard: This semantic table adds no navigation handler; native Tab reaches controls supplied in cells. The caller owns fetching, state and any retry actions. Loading sets aria-busy and renders hidden loading text; it does not establish a polite live region. Error uses role=alert around the supplied/default error content.

components.name: DatePicker
components.declaredKeyboard: Enter/Space on the field opens the popup; its Calendar uses native day/month buttons. Escape dismisses it. Date selection calls `onChange`; the consumer commits the selected value.

components.name: DescriptionList
components.declaredKeyboard: The metadata grid adds no keyboard action. Links or controls in term/value nodes retain their own behavior.

components.name: Dialog
components.declaredKeyboard: The shared modal layer moves focus, contains Tab and restores focus still owned by the closing layer. Escape, backdrop and any built-in close button call onClose; the parent updates controlled open. Composed actions own their behavior, including closing after submission.

components.name: Divider
components.declaredKeyboard: The separator adds no keyboard action. A rendered label uses the labelled horizontal branch; `vertical` applies to the unlabelled rule.

components.name: Dock
components.declaredKeyboard: Each native button is in Tab order and supports Enter/Space; focus also applies magnification. The wrapper does not add arrow-key roving. The caller handles onSelect and active state.

components.name: Drawer
components.declaredKeyboard: The shared modal layer moves focus, contains Tab and restores owned focus on closure. Escape, scrim and the close button call onClose; the parent must change open. The body is itself focusable for scrollable content.

components.name: Editor
components.declaredKeyboard: Native Tab reaches toolbar buttons and the editable area; Enter/Space activates toolbar commands while retaining the saved selection. Text editing uses the browser’s contentEditable behavior.

components.name: EmptyState
components.declaredKeyboard: The empty view adds no keyboard commands. Composed action controls retain their own focus and activation behavior.

components.name: FileUpload
components.declaredKeyboard: Tab reaches the labelled native file input. Picker keyboard behavior follows the browser/OS; the dropzone forwards selected/dropped files to `onFiles`.

components.name: FloatingActionButton
components.declaredKeyboard: Tab reaches the native main/action buttons; Enter/Space opens the dial or activates an action. Escape closes the dial through the shared overlay stack. With actions, the main button toggles the dial; without them it calls `onClick`.

components.name: Form
components.declaredKeyboard: Form uses native submission/reset controls and prevents submission while pending. FormField inherits its child’s keyboard behavior. FormFieldArray’s Add button and FormWizard navigation are native buttons; the caller provides any row-removal control. Custom non-native controls must respect pending context.

components.name: FormField
components.declaredKeyboard: Form uses native submission/reset controls and prevents submission while pending. FormField inherits its child’s keyboard behavior. FormFieldArray’s Add button and FormWizard navigation are native buttons; the caller provides any row-removal control. Custom non-native controls must respect pending context.

components.name: FormFieldArray
components.declaredKeyboard: Form uses native submission/reset controls and prevents submission while pending. FormField inherits its child’s keyboard behavior. FormFieldArray’s Add button and FormWizard navigation are native buttons; the caller provides any row-removal control. Custom non-native controls must respect pending context.

components.name: FormWizard
components.declaredKeyboard: Form uses native submission/reset controls and prevents submission while pending. FormField inherits its child’s keyboard behavior. FormFieldArray’s Add button and FormWizard navigation are native buttons; the caller provides any row-removal control. Custom non-native controls must respect pending context.

components.name: HotKeys
components.declaredKeyboard: The documented key combinations call onTrigger outside editing/composition/already-handled events. ? toggles the help sheet when enabled; Escape closes the modal through the shared overlay stack, which traps focus. Closed shadow hosts must guard editing events themselves.

components.name: HoverCard
components.declaredKeyboard: Supply a focusable trigger. This component renders trigger directly and does not create a focusable wrapper for text. Focus and hover keep the delayed panel open independently. Native Tab reaches interactive content; the preview does not trap focus. Escape dismisses and can return panel focus to the trigger. There is no click-to-toggle handler.

components.name: HumanReviewGate
components.declaredKeyboard: Tab reaches Reject and Approve; native Enter/Space activation invokes the corresponding caller callback. This UI does not enforce approval.

components.name: Icon
components.declaredKeyboard: The SVG adds no keyboard action. A labelled icon conveys an image name; action focus and activation belong to its surrounding control.

components.name: Image
components.declaredKeyboard: A loaded preview-enabled image enters Tab order; Enter/Space opens its lightbox. The shared modal layer traps focus and Escape closes it; the native close button also supports Enter/Space. Changing src or disabling preview closes the lightbox.

components.name: InlineEdit
components.declaredKeyboard: Enter/Space on the view button starts editing. Enter outside IME composition or blur commits; Escape cancels through the overlay stack. Supply `label` to name the editing input.

components.name: InputGroup
components.declaredKeyboard: Uses native input editing. Tab reaches available clear/reveal buttons and Enter/Space activates them. Read-only blocks value changes but permits password visibility changes.

components.name: InputOTP
components.declaredKeyboard: Typing advances focus; Backspace/delete/cut compact the code and paste replaces it. User edits filter ASCII digits. A controlled caller must supply digit content within `length`; this component does not verify the code. The Backspace shortcut ignores composition-marked/keyCode229 keydowns; ordinary edit, deletion and paste behavior remain unchanged.

components.name: Item
components.declaredKeyboard: With href, the row uses a native link activated by Enter; without href, onClick uses a native button activated by Enter/Space. Disabled rows become a noninteractive div with aria-disabled. An href takes precedence over the button callback. Avoid nested controls inside an interactive row.

components.name: Kbd
components.declaredKeyboard: This is a displayed key hint, not a shortcut listener. The consumer implements any command described by the hint.

components.name: Link
components.declaredKeyboard: A native anchor is reached with Tab and activated with Enter. external defaults to a new tab with noopener noreferrer; arrow glyphs are decorative.

components.name: List
components.declaredKeyboard: List adds list semantics. An interactive ListItem places a native Enter/Space button inside a listitem wrapper; static rows are listitems. Avoid nested interactive controls in a button row.

components.name: ListItem
components.declaredKeyboard: List adds list semantics. An interactive ListItem places a native Enter/Space button inside a listitem wrapper; static rows are listitems. Avoid nested interactive controls in a button row.

components.name: Logo
components.declaredKeyboard: The mark adds no keyboard action. When used inside a link, the link supplies navigation behavior and context.

components.name: LumiAvatar
components.declaredKeyboard: The avatar adds no keyboard action. If composed into a link or button, that parent owns focus, activation and its accessible name.

components.name: Masonry
components.declaredKeyboard: The CSS column wrapper adds no keyboard commands. Interactive children keep their DOM order and native keyboard behavior; visual placement runs top-to-bottom per column.

components.name: Mentions
components.declaredKeyboard: ArrowUp/Down move the active suggestion (`aria-activedescendant`); Enter selects; Escape closes. Mouse click still picks.

components.name: Menu
components.declaredKeyboard: Enter/Space or pointer activation opens and focuses the first enabled item. ArrowDown/ArrowUp on the trigger opens and focuses the first/last enabled item. Within the menu Up/Down wrap; Home/End reach the first/last item. Focus roves across enabled items, and printable keys perform prefix typeahead (500ms buffer; repeated letters cycle matches). Tab/Shift+Tab requests closure and continues sequential focus movement from the trigger, including within a parent modal. Escape requests closure through the shared layer and restores the trigger. Activation calls the item handler and requests closure unless its default was prevented. Composition, keyCode 229 and caller-prevented events are ignored. Custom triggers must forward keyboard/click events, ARIA and a focusable root.

components.name: MenuItem
components.declaredKeyboard: Enter/Space or pointer activation opens and focuses the first enabled item. ArrowDown/ArrowUp on the trigger opens and focuses the first/last enabled item. Within the menu Up/Down wrap; Home/End reach the first/last item. Focus roves across enabled items, and printable keys perform prefix typeahead (500ms buffer; repeated letters cycle matches). Tab/Shift+Tab requests closure and continues sequential focus movement from the trigger, including within a parent modal. Escape requests closure through the shared layer and restores the trigger. Activation calls the item handler and requests closure unless its default was prevented. Composition, keyCode 229 and caller-prevented events are ignored. Custom triggers must forward keyboard/click events, ARIA and a focusable root.

components.name: Menubar
components.declaredKeyboard: Left/Right wrap across top-level menus; Home/End reach the ends. Down/Up opens and focuses the first/last submenu item. Submenu Up/Down wraps, Home/End reaches ends, and Left/Right switches menus. Escape closes and restores the trigger; Tab closes while continuing native focus movement. Selection invokes caller onSelect.

components.name: NativeSelect
components.declaredKeyboard: Uses native select focus, navigation and selection; browser/OS popup behavior remains native.

components.name: NavItem
components.declaredKeyboard: Sidebar adds navigation structure; NavItem uses a native link for a nonempty href or a button otherwise. Tab/Enter follow links; Enter/Space activates buttons. active is caller-controlled and exposes aria-current=page.

components.name: NavigationMenu
components.declaredKeyboard: Tab reaches native panel buttons and links. Enter/Space toggles a panel button; Enter follows a link. Native Tab reaches panel links, selection closes the panel, and Escape dismisses through the shared overlay stack. This implementation adds no arrow-key navigation.

components.name: NumberField
components.declaredKeyboard: Uses native number-input keyboard entry/stepping. Tab also reaches the decrease/increase buttons; Enter/Space invokes native step alignment. Controlled callers update `value`.

components.name: OverlayProvider
components.declaredKeyboard: OverlayProvider provides a shared document manager and an empty portal host; it does not portal its children. Registered layers route Escape to the top non-toast layer, while the active modal contains Tab across registered owned scopes. Providers share the singleton. The 17 documented anchored panels use the shared body-portal/collision helper by default with an inline opt-out; custom consumer-created portals and modal placement remain caller-owned and require registered ownership for manager integration.

components.name: Pagination
components.declaredKeyboard: Tab reaches native page buttons; Enter/Space proposes an onChange page. The parent updates page. Supply a positive whole pageCount and a whole page in its range; this component does not normalize invalid caller state.

components.name: Popconfirm
components.declaredKeyboard: Native trigger Enter/Space opens through its click handler. Native Tab reaches confirmation actions; this nonmodal bubble does not trap focus. Escape and outside mousedown dismiss without invoking onCancel; the Cancel button invokes it. Confirm closes before notifying onConfirm. The caller owns the actual operation.

components.name: Popover
components.declaredKeyboard: Native trigger activation requests visibility; native Tab reaches panel content. This nonmodal panel does not trap focus or automatically focus its contents. Escape and outside mousedown request closure. Controlled open requires the caller to apply onOpenChange. The trigger must forward click and ARIA; preventDefault cancels toggling.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.declaredKeyboard: The progress display adds no keyboard action. Supply finite numeric progress and a positive finite maximum, plus a label that identifies the task.

components.name: PromptInput
components.declaredKeyboard: Enter submits nonblank input unless busy/disabled; Shift+Enter inserts a newline and IME confirmation does not submit. The native send button also supports Enter/Space.

components.name: PromptSuggestions
components.declaredKeyboard: Tab reaches each native suggestion button; Enter/Space passes its label to `onSelect`.

components.name: QRCode
components.declaredKeyboard: The code is a named image and adds no keyboard action. The caller supplies the four-module quiet zone around the encoded symbol and validates its real placement.

components.name: Radio
components.declaredKeyboard: Radio and RadioGroup use native radio keyboard behavior. Group members share a name; controlled callers update `value` from `onChange`. Provide a meaningful `legend` for group context.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.declaredKeyboard: Radio and RadioGroup use native radio keyboard behavior. Group members share a name; controlled callers update `value` from `onChange`. Provide a meaningful `legend` for group context.

components.name: Rating
components.declaredKeyboard: For editable whole-star values, arrows change the score and Home/End reach its bounds; native button activation selects or clears a star. Read-only stars are outside Tab order. Supply whole scores from zero through the rendered maximum.

components.name: Result
components.declaredKeyboard: The outcome view adds no keyboard commands. Composed action controls retain their own focus and activation behavior.

components.name: ScrollArea
components.declaredKeyboard: The overflow region has tabIndex zero by default, allowing native keyboard scrolling when content overflows. Caller native props may override tabIndex; provide an accessible region name when the panel needs identifiable context.

components.name: SearchField
components.declaredKeyboard: Uses native text editing. The clear button supports Enter/Space and is disabled with the input’s disabled/readOnly state. Supply an accessible name through native input props.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.declaredKeyboard: Horizontal uses Left/Right, vertical uses Up/Down; Home/End and wrapping select through `onChange`. Space/native Enter activate an option. Composing, canceled and other-axis keys retain browser behavior. The default radio mode uses `aria-checked`; resolved tabs mode uses `aria-selected`. Keep value controlled and, in tabs mode, caller-rendered panels in sync.

components.name: Select
components.declaredKeyboard: Uses native select keyboard navigation and selection; the chevron has no independent action.

components.name: Sidebar
components.declaredKeyboard: Sidebar adds navigation structure; NavItem uses a native link for a nonempty href or a button otherwise. Tab/Enter follow links; Enter/Space activates buttons. active is caller-controlled and exposes aria-current=page.

components.name: Skeleton
components.declaredKeyboard: The placeholder is decorative and hidden from assistive technology. It adds no keyboard action; the caller manages loading state and provides any meaningful status separately.

components.name: Slider
components.declaredKeyboard: Uses native range-input keyboard behavior for min/max/step. Provide a contextual accessible name using native ARIA props.

components.name: Sortable
components.declaredKeyboard: Native Tab reaches enabled move buttons; Enter/Space requests one adjacent reorder. The caller must apply onChange to items and provide unique keys. HTML5 drag is an enhancement; no change is emitted without a completed drop. Reorder helper indices should be valid whole numbers.

components.name: Spinner
components.declaredKeyboard: The status indicator adds no keyboard action; the caller controls whether loading is active.

components.name: Splitter
components.declaredKeyboard: Tab reaches the separator; Left/Right resize by two percentage points and respect inherited direction. Pointer movement changes internal state; there is no onChange callback. initial seeds state once. Use finite initial values, ordered finite percentage bounds within 0–100, and a useful positive height; arbitrary invalid numeric inputs are not normalized.

components.name: Stat
components.declaredKeyboard: The metric display adds no keyboard action; composed controls retain their own behavior.

components.name: StatusIndicator
components.declaredKeyboard: The status display adds no keyboard action. The dot is decorative; include a meaningful text label.

components.name: Steps
components.declaredKeyboard: The progress list adds no keyboard navigation or activation. The caller supplies current; current equal to steps.length marks all steps done.

components.name: Switch
components.declaredKeyboard: Uses the native checkbox’s focus and Space activation with `role="switch"`. Supply a label or explicit ARIA name that identifies the setting.

components.name: Tab
components.declaredKeyboard: Tabs uses the declared axis arrows plus Home/End, wrapping and automatic onChange requests; the parent supplies a value matching an item. Tab is a primitive native tab button: hand-composed lists must supply roving tabIndex, arrow handlers, IDs/panel relationships and selection/visibility themselves.

components.name: Tabs
components.declaredKeyboard: Tabs uses the declared axis arrows plus Home/End, wrapping and automatic onChange requests; the parent supplies a value matching an item. Tab is a primitive native tab button: hand-composed lists must supply roving tabIndex, arrow handlers, IDs/panel relationships and selection/visibility themselves.

components.name: Tag
components.declaredKeyboard: A static tag adds no keyboard action. With `onRemove`, Tab reaches a native remove button and Enter/Space invokes the callback; the caller removes the tag.

components.name: TagInput
components.declaredKeyboard: Enter/comma adds a trimmed nonduplicate tag; Backspace removes the last tag only when the draft is empty, and blur commits while enabled. IME composition does not commit. Native remove buttons support Enter/Space.

components.name: Terminal
components.declaredKeyboard: Enter executes a trimmed nonblank command through the synchronous caller callback, with IME composition guarded. It stores command/output history locally; welcome seeds the initial history and later welcome changes do not reset it.

components.name: TextField
components.declaredKeyboard: Uses native input editing, focus, disabled/readOnly and IME behavior; it adds no custom keyboard handler. Provide an accessible name through the local label, enclosing FormField or explicit ARIA naming, plus contextual native input attributes.

components.name: Textarea
components.declaredKeyboard: Uses native multiline editing and IME behavior; Enter inserts a newline. The wrapper adds no submission key handler.

components.name: TimePicker
components.declaredKeyboard: Uses native select keyboard navigation. `onChange` proposes an HH:MM value; the parent updates `value`.

components.name: Timeline
components.declaredKeyboard: The event trail adds no keyboard navigation or selection. Interactive nodes in supplied content retain their own behavior.

components.name: Toast
components.declaredKeyboard: ToastStack and the notification frame add no keyboard commands. Tab reaches a supplied close button; Enter/Space invokes `onClose`, and the caller owns removal and timing. Toast does not consume Escape from dismissible overlays.

components.name: ToastStack
components.declaredKeyboard: ToastStack and the notification frame add no keyboard commands. Tab reaches a supplied close button; Enter/Space invokes `onClose`, and the caller owns removal and timing. Toast does not consume Escape from dismissible overlays.

components.name: Toggle
components.declaredKeyboard: The native button supports Enter/Space. `onClick` runs before the toggle; preventing its default cancels the state change. Controlled callers update `pressed`.

components.name: Toolbar
components.declaredKeyboard: Left/Right and Home/End move among head buttons and the overflow button, stopping at the ends. Down/Enter/Space opens overflow and focuses its first item; Up/Down and Home/End move within it. Escape dismisses through the shared overlay stack. Native activation calls supplied onSelect. Use a nonnegative whole overflowAfter index.

components.name: Tooltip
components.declaredKeyboard: Native focus or pointer hover opens the description; Escape dismisses through the shared layer. Supply one focusable trigger forwarding aria-describedby. Trigger content and label should not contain interactive content in the bubble. The component adds no click-to-toggle handler.

components.name: Tour
components.declaredKeyboard: The shared modal layer contains Tab. Native buttons move steps or request closure; Escape and backdrop also call onClose. The parent updates controlled open. Supply valid CSS selectors; a valid selector with no matching target uses the unanchored fallback. Step changes do not add a live-region announcement.

components.name: Transfer
components.declaredKeyboard: Tab reaches native row checkboxes and move buttons; Space toggles a row and Enter/Space activates a move. Apply `onChange` to the caller-controlled target keys.

components.name: Tree
components.declaredKeyboard: Up/Down traverse visible nodes; Home/End reach the ends; Right opens or enters a branch; Left collapses or moves to the parent. Enter/Space requests selection and toggles a branch. selected is caller-controlled; branch state is internal. defaultOpen seeds new branches and preserves existing branch state across updates.

components.name: TreeSelect
components.declaredKeyboard: Enter/Space opens the field. Tree uses Up/Down, Home/End, Right to expand/enter and Left to collapse/return; Enter/Space selects a leaf or toggles a branch. Escape dismisses the popup. The consumer commits leaf selections through `value`.

components.name: TreeTable
components.declaredKeyboard: Native Tab reaches branch buttons; Enter/Space toggles expansion. This semantic nested-row table adds no APG treegrid arrow navigation. defaultExpanded seeds internal expansion once. Use unique node keys and meaningful first-cell content to name expansion buttons.

components.name: TypingIndicator
components.declaredKeyboard: The status indicator has no keyboard action. Rendering it is the consumer’s indication of activity; it does not detect model activity.

components.name: Watermark
components.declaredKeyboard: The watermark adds no keyboard action and does not intercept pointer input. Child controls keep their own behavior.
